services.desc: Azad's Adult Martial Arts program teaches effective self-defense, powerful fitness, and personal growth through Jongshindo - our comprehensive martial arts system combining stand-up striking, ground techniques, throws, locks, and traditional weapons training. Adults learn powerful stand-up, ground, throwing, locking, holds, submission, and traditional as well as modified weapons skills. Whether your goal is self-defense, fitness, stress relief, or personal development, our progressive curriculum meets you where you are and helps you grow at your own pace.
